title: vitis serpens
intro: Vitis serpens, commonly known as the grapevine, is a type of plant species that belongs to the Vitaceae family. The health benefits of Vitis serpens include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of antioxidants and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of Vitis serpens are thought to be attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Vitis serpens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and resveratrol, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects.
